title: 茶園的一天
intent: 拍一支茶農清晨採茶的短紀錄片

style.look: Realistic documentary footage, natural available light, observational, true-to-life color
style.ambience: birdsong, light wind through the leaves, distant rooster
style.music: sparse solo guqin melody, very quiet

script.body:
| 旁白 | 畫面 |
|---|---|
| 清晨五點，阿明已經在茶園裡。 | 茶園全景，薄霧 |

subjects.name: 阿明
subjects.appearance: Taiwanese tea farmer in his 60s, tanned weathered face, short grey hair
subjects.wardrobe: faded blue work shirt, conical bamboo hat
subjects.kinematic_signature: slightly stooped, picks with quick small finger movements

environments.name: 茶園
environments.description: terraced tea garden on a misty hillside in Nantou
environments.light: soft dawn light from the left, low sun

shots.narration: 清晨五點，阿明已經在茶園裡。
shots.focus: Ming's hands and face, moderate depth of field
shots.composition: Ming on the left third, rows of tea leading to the misty hills
shots.action: Ming picks tea leaves along a row

shots.focus: his face and the leaves, shallow depth of field
shots.action: Ming smells a handful of leaves and smiles

shots.scene: The garden he has kept for forty years
shots.narration: 這片茶園，他守了四十年。
shots.composition: Ming small in the lower third, terraces filling the frame
shots.action: Ming walks between rows, tiny in the landscape
